summary: WinVest Acquisition Corp. (a SPAC) filed an 8-K announcing an amended business combination agreement with Embed Financial Group Holdings. The Restated Business Combination Agreement establishes an ADS facility with BNY Mellon, under which Company and SPAC shares will be exchanged for Pubco ADSs. No financial terms (price, premium) or advisor names are disclosed. The filing amends a previously disclosed December 2025 agreement. The SPAC structure and de-SPAC merger indicate a business combination process. The target role reflects the SPAC as the acquired shell. Watch for shareholder vote, redemption risk, and regulatory clearance timeline.
